about: Scripted Profile Builder conversations for CFS-144. Every person is fictional. Each user turn is labelled answer (gives career information) or other (no career information: small talk, questions, off-topic, frustration, injection). expect lists values that should appear in the profile draft (pending proposals) after the last turn, matched case-insensitively. mayAdvance marks a non-answer where moving on is also right (the user asked to stop that question).
